The Dust Admin team will contact you to organise a short review meeting and discuss the agent, its use case and any potential improvements before publication.

If you have any questions in the meantime, you can contact us at dust@carmignac.com.

Review the agent with the builder: business need, data access, connectors, permissions, output, performance, risks and potential improvements.
